info.description:
Gym Marketplace & Multi-Tenant Gym Management SaaS.

Errors use the §C3.1 envelope: `{ error: { code, message, details[], correlation_id } }`.

Money crosses the wire as a STRING of integer minor units (paise for INR), never a JSON number — a JSON number loses integer precision above 2^53 (TR-38, BR-PAY-01).

The tenant is derived from the access token and is NEVER accepted from a client header, path, query or body (BR-TEN-01, §11.3).
